project_info.application_name: Electric Vehicle Charging Station Management System
project_info.network_architecture: Cloud-based microservices architecture with multiple load balancers. Network Load Balancer fronts OCPP connection handler for charging station communications. Application Load Balancer (component 7) routes traffic between microservices. External actors (charge point operators, fleet management, smart meters, roaming networks) connect through various endpoints. Internal communication between microservices through load balancing.
key_components: OCPP connection handler (component 1) - handles charging station protocol communications with ELB, Fargate, DynamoDB, Lambda
Web application (component 2) - operator interface using CloudFront, API Gateway, Cognito, S3
EVSE registry (component 3) - manages charging station registry with Fargate, DynamoDB, Certificate Manager
EVSE management (component 4) - delivers metrics and logs using Fargate, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, S3
Smart charging (component 5) - handles charging optimization with Fargate and DynamoDB
Transaction management and audit (component 6) - immutable transaction logging using Fargate and QLDB
Elastic Load Balancing (component 7) - central routing and load balancing between microservices
